title: Canopy Drive Actuator & Latch Mechanism
summary: Aft-hinged electromechanical actuator and multipoint locking hooks that raise and seal the single-piece frameless bubble canopy.
role: Opens and closes the heavy bird-strike-resistant polycarbonate canopy and locks it for cockpit pressurization.
materials: High-strength titanium/steel linkages and electromechanical drive.
